summary: Estimate the average total effect of proactive guidance on future engagement.
The main DoWhy adjusted estimate is 0.835; the known teaching ATE is 0.850.
Regression, matching, stratification, and weighting estimates are directionally consistent.
Observed covariate imbalance is substantial before adjustment and much smaller after weighting.
Placebo and negative-control checks behave as expected in the teaching data.
The result still depends on the no-unmeasured-confounding assumption.
Use this analysis to justify a prospective experiment or a more controlled rollout design.
